title: Several Rental Reservations Held by One Customer
content:
**Rule.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination a customer may hold more than one reservation at once only for different vehicles in repair; there is no customer-level cap on the number of reservations. Per repair, the rule of at most one open reservation per insurance claim repair order, customer-pay repair order or warranty coverage applies.

## Points of judgement

- **Number per customer**: no figure caps how many reservations one customer may hold at once.
- **What separates the reservations**: each reservation held at the same time is for a different vehicle in repair.
- **Within one repair**: one repair order or warranty coverage still has at most one open reservation.

## Hypothetical cases

- A fleet manager has three vehicles in network repairs at the same time. Three reservations at once, one per vehicle, sit within this rule, since there is no customer-level cap.
- A customer asks for two reservations at once for the same vehicle in repair. More than one reservation at once is held only for different vehicles in repair, so the second does not fall within this rule.
